card.name: The www in web addresses
card.fires_on: The letters "www" right after "https://" or "http://" at the start of a web address. Strongest in label text pointing to FDA companion diagnostics pages.

modes.label: FDA test links
modes.description: The www after https:// in a sentence saying information on FDA-authorized tests is available at a link.
modes.example: Information on FDA-authorized tests for the detection of ESR1 mutations in breast cancer is available at: https://<<www>>.fda.gov/CompanionDiagnostics

modes.label: Other web links
modes.description: The www after http:// in other references, such as health agency pages or citation lists.

card.plain: It marks the "www" that starts a web address, mostly in links to FDA pages.
